items.ref: FIRST / BLOCKING: Starting a work session must put work on its own branch (and worktree) for isolation. work session == branch == own tree. Fix at the work-session / start-ticket layer so every new work session binds to session/<name> with its own worktree before any job runs. After start-ticket, rebind workspace root to that worktree.
CliAgent session log incomplete vs design: response summaries, links to content/chat/job queue, fold cli-agent.json IDs into session log header.
CliAgent /loop job-finished notifications not firing; poll ~30s for doer then judge completion and report.
Finding CliAgent logs is painful; introspect paths and put them in parent prompt / launch report.
launch_sessions NOT TAKEN UP pickup flake when spawn already succeeded.

Duplicate doer spawned when NOT TAKEN UP fires: launch_next has no guard to detect an already-running doer for the same session before opening a second console. Fix: check for a live doer process matching the session resume ID before spawning, and surface a clear status rather than a second window.
